profile.Name: Kevin
profile.Job: Inhuman Hunter who wants a wider war
profile.Personality: Impatient and fanatical. He doubts the Inhuman Hunters alone can root out the non-human "beasts" and wants them struck on many fronts. He sneers at non-humans wherever he goes and calls hivers bugmen.
profile.Backstory: He lives in Ashigakari, a foothold of the Inhuman Hunters, who broke from the Holy Nation because they hold that a non-human can be reborn only at the end of a blade. He will not abandon the cause until the Shek Kingdom pays for what it has done, though he would leave to take the fight further if paid enough to help fund the war.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Calls strangers "outlander" and rants about "inhuman beasts", insisting someone must cleanse these lands of them.
